transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Well, I guess what really pushed me to make this appointment is... I've just been having these intense reactions at work. I work as a receptionist, and lately, every time a door slams, or even if someone just rolls a suitcase fast across the lobby, I jump. It feels like... like it’s happening all over again. And then it takes me a solid minute or so just to get my heart rate back down to normal. It's just really starting to bother me, so I figured I should talk to someone about it.
When you say it feels like it's happening all over again, are you referring to a specific traumatic event from your past?

Yeah... yeah, I am. This whole thing has been going on for about two weeks now. 

There was an incident where a guest actually threatened me right at the front desk. It got pretty intense, and, um... ever since that happened, I've just been reacting this way.
